sources.title: Effects of 50 Hz pulsed electromagnetic fields on the growth and cell cycle arrest of mesenchymal stem cells: an in vitro study

comparison_facts.claim: Study reports significant early proliferation increase for exposed mesenchymal cells relative to control.
Growth after 3-hour and 6-hour exposure did not differ significantly.
Exposed cell G1-phase proportion increased relative to control, with greater G1 percentage after 6 hours than 3 hours.
By 16 hours after treatment, the source reports no significant proliferation or cell-cycle effect.

missing_for_admission: exact sham-specific assay-by-duration outcome and p
late observation time for each exposure arm
sources.caution: An absence of difference between 3h and 6h is not evidence that neither differs from sham; post-exposure 16h null cannot be assigned to the early timepoint.

sources.title: The time-dependent manner of sinusoidal electromagnetic fields on rat bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells proliferation, differentiation, and mineralization

comparison_facts.claim: Source reports duration-dependent osteogenic RUNX2, BSP, OPN expression, ALP activity and calcium deposition.
MEK/ERK inhibition reduced proliferation and partly attenuated osteogenic-expression responses.

missing_for_admission: exact exposure duration for each comparison
full-text Table/Figure locator and effect direction per comparison
sources.caution: Cannot infer a numeric duration or assign the aggregate proliferation/mineralization increase to every dose window. MEK/ERK is not a verified direct EMF sensor.

sources.title: Exposure to extremely low frequency magnetic fields has no effect on growth rate or clonogenic potential of multipotential haemopoietic progenitor cells
sources.system: Mouse FDCP-mix(A4) multipotential haemopoietic progenitor cell line

comparison_facts.claim: Across the tested exposure regimes and durations, authors report no significant alteration of growth rate, cell-cycle state, or clonogenic efficiency.

missing_for_admission: separation of 50 Hz vertical arm from ambient/nulled controls
confirmed reference field for each outcome
sources.caution: Do not encode a nulled-field condition as 50 Hz/6 microtesla exposure. A pooled null across several regimes and 1/4/7/21 days is not 16 independent null findings.

sources.title: Exposure to extremely low-frequency (50 Hz) electromagnetic fields enhances adult hippocampal neurogenesis in C57BL/6 mice

comparison_facts.claim: Study-level report of enhanced hippocampal neurogenesis.

sources.caution: Do not infer the effect under each exposure duration from the title.
